overall_status: "ready" | "not_ready" | "needs_confirmation"
summary_zh: 一句话结论
requirements: 数组，每项含 id, item, necessity("required"|"conditional"|"optional"), condition(null), applicability("applies"|"not_applicable"|"unknown"), status("ready"|"missing"|"expired"|"conflict"|"needs_confirmation"|"not_applicable"), matched_inventory_ids, reason, evidence([{source_id, locator, quote}])
